title: ReconciliationSummary
description: Return value of ReconciliationWorkflow. Counts surface in the ReconciliationCompleted audit event subject; individual discrepancies are audited as separate JournalOrphan / BrokerOrphan events at detection time.

journal_orphans.description: Journal rows in non-terminal state with no matching broker order (and recorded_at older than 5 min).

broker_orphans.description: Broker open orders with client_order_id not in journal.

position_orphans.description: Issue #165: broker-held positions with no running PositionWorkflow. Optional + back-compat: older consumers (and older workflow versions) that don't set this field still parse cleanly.
